source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh enable: TRUE c. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. CPU Common Options → SMU and PSP Debug Mode: Disabled e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listtwixwafllinks 6. Uncorrectable error injection at CCD sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --twixwafl --linknumber 0 --errorlocation 1 --errortype 1 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

required_package: Socket/CCD/CCX/core/NUMA-to-TXWAFL topology and link0/location1 coverage map
Vendor proof of --twixwafl errortype1 and location1 semantics
Authoritative replacement or approval for duplicated correctable acceptance language
FF5/FFE threshold encoding, CCD/TXWAFL relevance and raw restore values
CCD-specific fresh MCA/CPER/BERT/SEL fields and expected containment/reset
Supported OS, timeout, core/NUMA/memory/fabric recovery limits, aborts and restoration
test_case.test_command: Map socket, CCD, TXWAFL link and direction; prove link0/location1/errortype1 semantics; preserve raw settings and log baselines; inject once under OOB capture; decode a fresh CCD/TXWAFL MCA/CPER/BERT source; verify CCD cores, NUMA node, memory access and inter-die traffic; restore all threshold, BIOS and HDT state.
